tree.name: Creative
tree.description: Design, creative tools, visual references, assets, content creation, and interface ideas.

profile.summary: Use when the saved material is mainly useful for visual, creative, design, or content production work. Do not use only because an item has an image preview.
negative_examples: Movie news saved for release information.
AI model benchmark with no creative workflow.

children.name: UI & UX

profile.summary: Use for interface and experience material: UI patterns, UX flows, components, states, usability ideas, design systems, and product interaction examples.
positive_examples: Beautiful transition collection for web design.
negative_examples: React implementation detail without design angle.

children.name: Design References

positive_examples: Visual benchmark for a product page.
negative_examples: Useful website list with no visual reason.
Film release saved for watching later.
